source.shape_note: One row per (time, entity, bodypart). A wide export with one column per bodypart is a different shape and needs its own profile; this first implementation is deliberately narrow rather than guessing at a universal reshaper.
source.tool_independence: This profile names roles, never vendor columns. DeepLabCut, SLEAP, MoSeq and hand-scored output all reach VAWLUME through the same declaration by pointing each role at whatever the exporting tool happened to call it.

context.coordinate_note: The coordinate system must already be declared for the project. Tracking never creates a frame implicitly, because doing so would let an import choose its own units and dimensionality.

confidence.confidence_note: Optional. A tracker that emits none produces a stream with has_confidence = 0, and readers report the absence rather than substituting a value.

bodypart_roles.justification: This project's snout label denotes the same landmark as the canonical snout role. The native label is preserved regardless; the canonical role is additive.

checks.expression: position_x and position_y resolve to real columns of the supplied table
every row carries a nonempty track_label and bodypart_label
checks.reason: A sample with no identity cannot be attributed to a trace. Assigning it to a default series would invent identity the source did not supply.

checks.expression: the column required by native_time_basis resolves, and a frame-only profile declares nominal_frame_rate_hz

mapping_policy.dense_samples_note: Registration stores the logical stream, its traces, and its column contract. Positions, frames and confidences stay in the artifact and are read window-wise on demand.
